entities.summary: Kaleena Jordan Mosqueda-Lewis is an American professional basketball player for the Ballarat Miners. Prior to enrolling at the University of Connecticut she played for Mater Dei High School in Santa Ana, California. Mosqueda-Lewis was named the 2011 State Farm/WBCA High School Player of the Year by the Women's Basketball Coaches Association. In 2015 Mosqueda-Lewis was drafted third overall by the Seattle Storm, going on to win a WNBA championship with the franchise in 2018.
